protocol.description:
Protocol for exposing gamepad/controller input events to Wayland clients.
A global interface that notifies clients about connected gamepad devices and delivers button and axis state changes. Each gamepad is identified by a device ID.
Warning! The protocol described in this file is experimental and backward incompatible changes may be made. Backward compatible changes may be added together with the corresponding interface version bump. Backward incompatible changes are done by bumping the version number in the protocol and interface names and resetting the interface version. Once the protocol is to be declared stable, the 'z' prefix and the version number in the protocol and interface names are removed and the interface version number is reset.

interface.name: zwp_gamepad_manager_v1
interface.description:
The global interface exposing gamepad device enumeration and events. A client binds this interface to receive gamepad connection, disconnection, button, and axis events.
Gamepad events are delivered in batches delimited by a frame event. Clients should defer processing until they receive a frame event.

request.name: destroy
request.description: Destroy the gamepad manager. Any gamepad objects created through this manager remain valid until the corresponding gamepad_removed event is received.

event.name: gamepad_added
event.description: Notifies the client that a gamepad device has been connected. The client can expect button and axis events for this device id.

event.name: gamepad_removed
event.description: Notifies the client that a gamepad device has been disconnected. The device id is no longer valid.

event.name: gamepad_button
event.description: Notifies the client about a gamepad button press or release. Button indices are 0-based and follow the standard Xbox layout: 0=A, 1=B, 2=X, 3=Y, 4=LB, 5=RB, 6=LT, 7=RT, 8=Back, 9=Start, 10=LS, 11=RS, 12=DUp, 13=DDown, 14=DLeft, 15=DRight, 16=Home

event.name: gamepad_axis
event.description:
Notifies the client about a gamepad analog axis value. Axis indices are 0-based: 0=LX (left stick X), 1=LY (left stick Y), 2=RX (right stick X), 3=RY (right stick Y), 4=LT (left trigger), 5=RT (right trigger), 6=HAT_X (d-pad X), 7=HAT_Y (d-pad Y)
Values are normalized to [-1.0, 1.0], except triggers which are [0.0, 1.0].

event.name: gamepad_frame
event.description: Indicates the end of a set of gamepad events that occurred simultaneously. Clients should process all pending state changes on receipt of this event.
